normalization.hashes: Source hashes describe original evaluation bytes; published hashes describe normalized JSON. CSV bytes are unchanged. Manifest does not include its own hash.
normalization.history: Commands, original checkpoint paths, selection-lock paths and hash-bound selection/evidence objects stay historical; only ROOT prefix is sanitized.
normalization.native_cf: Native CF emits no initial_scene.json or invocation.json; none is fabricated. Its completed index contains the real invocation and guard evidence.
normalization.omissions: Logs, trajectories, videos, caches, shim executables and model/optimizer weights are not published.
normalization.paths: Only this checkout absolute ROOT prefix becomes ${REPO}; copied artifact reference values point to reports/.
